_comment: Variant A — faster EMA, tighter RSI filter, smaller ATR stop. More signals, higher noise risk.
rationale: Shorter EMAs react faster to price changes, generating more entry signals. Tighter RSI range (40-60) keeps entries closer to neutral momentum, filtering out more extremes. Smaller stop (-2.5%) reduces per-trade loss but may cause more premature exits in volatile conditions. Best candidate for ranging or low-volatility markets.
